exposure: Excisional surgery (CSP excision and hysterotomy closure)
Conservative surgery (vacuum aspiration and surgical hysteroscopy)
cohort: The study participants were 464 CSP patients with a residual myometrium thickness <=3 mm who underwent surgical management in China between January 1, 2019, and December 31, 2021.
finding: For CSP patients with a thinner residual myometrium, excisional surgery significantly improved the subsequent pregnancy rate and effectively reduced the risk of CSP recurrence compared to conservative surgery.
followup_time: Up to January 31, 2025 (data collected on pregnancy outcomes after initial treatment)
gest_age: Excluded if gestational age greater than 12 weeks
